name: week
title: This week
subtitle: What needs a person: legal and deed deadlines first, then the year end and beneficiary requests

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: The dated obligations from /attention. Every line names the rule that set it.
sections.sql: select trust, item, ref, due_on as due, standing, basis from v_obligations where standing in ('overdue', 'due soon') order by case basis when 'law' then 0 when 'deed' then 1 else 2 end, due_on

sections.title: Resolutions not signed by every trustee
sections.sql: select ref, trust, made_on, kind, signed || ' of ' || trustees_then as signed, unsigned_by from v_resolutions where signed < trustees_then order by made_on desc

sections.title: Beneficiary requests waiting
sections.sql: select q.ref, t.code as trust, p.name as beneficiary, q.received_on, q.asked_for from info_requests q join trusts t on t.id = q.trust_id join people p on p.id = q.person_id where q.answered_on is null order by q.received_on

name: year-end
title: Year end
subtitle: Every trust's last finished income year: resolution, distributions and accounts

sections.title: Resolutions and accounts
sections.note: New Zealand: beneficiary income vested or paid within 6 months of balance date (Income Tax Act 2007 s HC 6). Australia: resolve by 30 June or the deed's earlier date (ITAA 1936 ss 97 and 99A).
sections.sql: select t.code as trust, t.jurisdiction, o.income_year, o.item, o.due_on, o.done_on, o.standing from v_obligations o join trusts t on t.id = o.trust_id where o.item in ('beneficiary income allocated', 'distribution resolution', 'financial statements') and o.income_year >= extract(year from current_date)::int - 1 order by t.code, o.income_year desc, o.item

name: register
title: Register of people
subtitle: Every current trustee, settlor, appointor and beneficiary, trust by trust

sections.title: Current roles
sections.sql: select trust, name, role, from_on, age from v_register where standing = 'current' order by trust, case role when 'trustee' then 0 when 'settlor' then 1 when 'appointor' then 2 else 3 end, name

name: money
title: Trust property and loans
subtitle: What each trust holds, when it was valued, and what it still owes

sections.title: Assets
sections.sql: select t.code as trust, a.description, a.kind, (a.value_cents / 100.0)::numeric(14,2) as value, case when t.jurisdiction = 'NZ' then 'NZD' else 'AUD' end as currency, a.valued_on from assets a join trusts t on t.id = a.trust_id where a.disposed_on is null and t.status = 'active' order by t.code, a.value_cents desc nulls last

sections.title: Loans
sections.sql: select trust, lender, direction, (balance_cents / 100.0)::numeric(14,2) as balance, currency, last_forgiven_on from v_loans order by trust
